description: List the curated, verified high-value datasets available from data.gov.my / OpenDOSM (Dept of Statistics Malaysia). data.gov.my exposes no machine listing/search endpoint, so this returns a hand-verified set covering inflation, GDP, labour, prices, income, population and demography, with each dataset id, topic, description and its value columns. Optionally filter by topic.
name: opendosm_list_datasets
title: Opendosm List Datasets
